ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding and rolling screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, and Bermuda domestic sanctions lists; enhanced due diligence (EDD) with source-of-wealth and senior-management approval for all Politically Exposed Persons per FATF Recommendation 12 and BMA guidance; risk-rating adopts the 'Low_Risk_Standard' tier for bona fide Chinese franchise operators with documented licensed-source funds; non-verified PEP or sanctions match is a hard stop to incorporation; five-year record retention applies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies - Companies Registry (online name reservation is effected exclusively through licensed Bermuda Corporate Service Providers; public registry portal: roc.gov.bm)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Legal company name must be in English/Latin script; Chinese characters cannot form part of the registered legal name. A pinyin transliteration (e.g., 'MALATANG') is permitted as a registered business/style name; Chinese characters may be used only as a marketing brand or as a non-registered translation. Any bilingual corporate document filed in Bermuda must be accompanied by a certified English translation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed CSP files a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days; where rejection is due to a restricted token, an application for prior ministerial consent is submitted to the appropriate Minister; concurrently, the applicant may submit an alternate name reservation. Final recourse is an administrative appeal to the Minister responsible for registry matters, followed by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the statutory registered office. Companies Act 1981 s.128 requires a physical registered office in Bermuda maintained by a licensed Corporate Service Provider. A virtual back-office may be used for administrative consolidation, but the registered address must be a real, inspected Bermuda location. The underlying Chinese Malatang franchise operations must be licensed at the place of trade; Bermuda serves as the exempted holding/IP-licensing vehicle only.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated less than 10% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the CSP-registered office for a standard exempted company; inspections are predominantly triggered by sanctions/PEP flags or inconsistent substance filings. Routine BMA examinations are conducted via the CSP's records rather than at the company premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), ss. 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 43A (registered office), 87A (audit exemption), 110 (fees) and Schedule 3; Business Licensing Act 1964 for operating licence.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Corporate Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (Companies eRegistry portal)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon approval of the Exempted Company Incorporation Application accompanied by the Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the exempted company may issue a single share at par. Common structure is USD 12,000 authorised capital divided into 12,000 shares of USD 1.00 with one share subscribed for cash or agreed value. No escrow or capital deposit account is required by the Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation and the initial allotment of fully paid shares to the subscribers be and hereby are approved, and that share certificates be issued forthwith. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office at [address], Bermuda be adopted, and that [name] be appointed resident representative to accept service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, [name] Chief Financial Officer, and [name] Company Secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the officers be authorised to open bank accounts, execute restaurant licence applications, and complete environmental, health, and fire safety registrations required for opening the Malatang self-serve premises.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda, through a licensed corporate service provider on the Companies eRegistry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a Bermuda-licensed registered agent to run the name availability search and hold a first right of refusal over the proposed company name. Submit the name reservation application with two alternative names. The name must end with Limited, Corp., Ltd., or Inc. to indicate limited liability.
required_dossiers: AML/KYC documents of ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar refuses a name as confusingly similar, the agent may file a written requisition response within 14 days or immediately activate the alternate reserved name; no appeal fee is charged for substitution of the alternate name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarisation of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws in English with an objects clause broad enough to cover fast-casual franchise licensing and restaurant operations. Execute the Memorandum before a notary or attorney in Bermuda or abroad with legalisation or apostille, and obtain consent letters from the proposed directors, secretary, and resident representative.
required_dossiers: Consent to act forms of first directors and officers
Consent and appointment form of resident representative
Registered office confirmation from the agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any drafting requisition from the Registrar by an amended document and re-execution; notarial defects are cured by re-execution before the notary with a fresh certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Corporate Registry, Government of Bermuda (Companies eRegistry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Exempted Company Incorporation Application with the signed Memorandum of Association, Bye-laws, declaration of compliance, and consent forms. Pay the official government filing fee of USD 1,795 for authorised capital up to USD 12,000 by bank transfer or agent clearing account. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Declaration of compliance with Companies Act 1981
Consent to act of first directors, secretary and resident representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any Registrar requisition or clarification request within 21 days; amend the declaration and resubmit. If the application is refused, a corrected fresh application can be filed, or judicial review may be sought from the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and registered agent in Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting, adopt the pro forma board resolution, allot and issue the initial shares, and open the statutory books: register of members, register of directors and officers, register of charges, and minute book. File the notice of appointment of directors, secretary, resident representative, and registered office with the Registrar within the prescribed period, typically within 30 days.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes and resolutions
Appointment notice for resident representative and registered office
Annual compliance calendar and audit-exemption election if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or defective notices are corrected by voluntary supplementary filings; statutory penalties can be mitigated by a written explanation and prompt rectification under the Registrar's error-correction procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Business Licensing Authority, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the restaurant business licence application specifying the Malatang self-serve format, the managed franchise model, estimated gross receipts, and the premises lease or ownership details. Pay the licence assessment fee once calculated; the licence is issued annually and a copy must be displayed at the premises.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and register of officers
Proposed menu and self-serve food safety plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or objected to, the applicant may submit written representations and revised data within 21 days and may appeal the final decision to the Minister of Finance; a temporary licence may be granted for the fit-out period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Health, Environmental, and Fire Safety Clearance for Premises Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Health (Environmental Health Section), Department of Environment and Natural Resources, and Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the premises fit-out drawings and HACCP-based food safety plan to the Department of Health for the Food Establishment Permit, register the trade effluent and grease interceptor arrangement with the environmental health officer, and obtain a fire safety inspection clearance before any public opening. Schedule the initial opening inspection at least 10 business days in advance.
required_dossiers: Grease trap and waste water design details
Fire safety compliance and occupancy application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any deficiency notice must be remedied within the stated period and a re-inspection requested; refused permits may be appealed to the Chief Medical Officer or the Fire and Rescue Service commissioner, as applicable, within 21 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Business Licensing Authority (Ministry of Finance) acting with the Department of Health for food-safety regulated restaurant operations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Restaurant Business Licence under the Business Licensing Act 1964 and Food Establishment Permit under the Public Health legislation; where the exempted company operates locally in Bermuda, a special local-business permission from the Minister of Finance under the Companies Act 1981 is also required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental review under the Development and Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 1999. A small Malatang self-serve restaurant is ordinarily a Registration or Exempt-tier development; a full EIA report is triggered only for premises discharging trade effluent above the regulatory threshold, located in coastal conservation zones, or involving major new construction.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Kitchen trade effluent must pass through a properly sized grease and oil interceptor and comply with the trade effluent quality limits of the Bermuda Water Authority and Department of Health, including pH 6.0-9.0 and applicable BOD, COD, TSS, and total recoverable hydrocarbon schedules, with no untreated discharge to watercourses or marine waters. Kitchen exhaust must meet odour and VOC abatement requirements; solid waste, used cooking oil, and food waste must be handled by licensed collection and recycling contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and inspection by the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service covering means of escape, suppression systems, and commercial cooking equipment; structural load and occupancy clearance from the Department of Planning Building Control; work environment clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Regulations including first aid, ventilation, electrical safety, and food handler health certificates.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Department of Revenue – Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda; official portal: www.gov.bm
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities forming a Bermuda Exempted Company obtain a Certificate of Incorporation from the Registrar of Companies via a licensed corporate service provider. Bermuda does not levy income tax, VAT, or sales tax, and therefore no general corporate tax identification number is issued. Statutory registrations apply only in specific trigger situations: (1) if the entity employs individuals in Bermuda, it must register as an employer for Payroll Tax with the Office of the Tax Commissioner; (2) if it imports goods into Bermuda, it must register with the Bermuda Customs Administration for a Customs Duty Account; (3) a Bermuda Business Number (BBN) may be required for electronic government transactions. The standard procedure is: (a) incorporate and file constitutional documents; (b) apply for a Tax Solvent Certificate / Tax Protection Certificate where available; (c) register for payroll tax only where local employees exist; (d) register for customs duty only where physical imports occur; (e) obtain sectoral licensing where required (e.g., food franchise and trademark licensing activities are generally unregulated but may require trade licensing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda has no domestic check-the-box election. An Exempted Company may apply under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 for a Tax Protection Certificate guaranteeing freedom from Bermuda taxes introduced after the date of incorporation until at least 2035. For United States federal tax purposes, the entity may file IRS Form 8832 to elect classification as a corporation, partnership, or disregarded entity. For UK tax purposes, the entity is ordinarily non-UK tax resident unless centrally managed and controlled in the UK; hybrid mismatch rules under Part 21A CTA 2010 must be considered where the entity is treated as fiscally transparent in one jurisdiction and opaque in another.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax – Bermuda levies only customs import duties and employer payroll tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – Bermuda has no VAT/GST turnover threshold. A Customs Duty Account is required for any entity importing goods into Bermuda, regardless of turnover. Payroll tax registration is required from the first BMD of Bermuda payroll.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable – Bermuda has no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, or digital stamping regime for indirect tax. Customs import entries are processed electronically through the Bermuda Customs Automated Commercial Environment; franchise royalty invoices are not subject to fiscal clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – Bermuda does not impose VAT/GST, so there is no export zero-rating claim or refund mechanism. Exports of goods are generally exempt from Bermuda customs duty, and cross-border services (including fast-casual franchise licence royalties) are entirely outside Bermuda's indirect tax net.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No VAT/GST zero-rating refund scheme exists in Bermuda; therefore no statutory customs documentation bundle is required. Standard export evidence for commercial and customs purposes is a commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/airway bill, and any Bermuda Customs export declaration if the goods are subject to export control.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT/GST clawback penalty applies in Bermuda because there is no VAT/GST system. For customs duty purposes, false declarations, undervaluation, or unauthorized importation may result in forfeiture, monetary penalties under the Bermuda Customs Act, and in serious cases criminal prosecution. The franchise licensing structure itself has no indirect tax audit exposure; the primary compliance risk is limited to payroll tax and customs duty reporting errors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) — Bermuda's central bank and integrated financial services regulator; administers the Exchange Control Act 1972 and the Exchange Control Regulations; the Bermuda dollar (BMD) operates under a hard peg of BMD 1 = USD 1.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The BMD is fully convertible at a fixed 1:1 USD peg, and both capital and current accounts are effectively open for a Bermuda Exempted Company designated 'non-resident' under the Exchange Control Act 1972. That designation confers general exchange-control permission: the entity may hold, borrow, lend, invest and remit in any foreign currency (USD, GBP, CNY) without case-by-case BMA approval. Profit remittance is unrestricted: Bermuda levies no income tax, corporate tax, withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties, or capital gains tax applicable to the Exempted Company, so no tax clearance is required before remitting royalty receipts or capital distributions to the UK parent. The only practical hurdle is settlement infrastructure: all non-BMD flows must clear through US-dollar correspondent banking in New York (CHIPS/Fedwire), and no domestic CNY or GBP clearing exists in Bermuda.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation or mandatory conversion ratio applies to a Bermuda Exempted Company designated 'non-resident' under the Exchange Control Act 1972: it may retain 100% of export and royalty proceeds denominated in USD or any other foreign currency, with no prescribed surrender timeline and a 0% mandatory conversion obligation. The BMA retains a reserve power to impose exchange-control directions on Bermuda-resident entities, but the non-resident designation removes this Exempted Company from the general requirement to offer foreign currency to an authorized dealer; a notice of non-resident designation issued by the registered agent must be maintained on file for each banking relationship.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.capital_account_liberalization_note: Not required by schema; omitted intentionally
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.repatriation_and_withholding_notes: Not required by schema; omitted intentionally

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (share subscription reserve) and multi-currency Operational Account (USD/BMD)
Operational Account (USD/BMD multi-currency) with intra-group link to HSBC UK for SWIFT GPI coverage
Operational Account (USD/BMD) for secondary treasury and sweep purposes
Operational Account (private banking focus; best suited to high-value single-client treasury) — generally not required for this structure

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with material legal caveats. BMA-regulated fintech or EMI presence in Bermuda is minimal; practical support comes from UK/EU FCA-authorized digital EMIs (for example Airwallex, Currenxie, Revolut Business) that can lawfully maintain USD/GBP multi-currency operational accounts for a Bermuda Exempted Company and host SWIFT MT103 royalty wires. Legal constraints: (1) funds are held by the EMI's program bank, not the EMI itself, creating tiered counterparty and insolvency risk; (2) most EMI compliance policies restrict offshore entities unless the customer demonstrates substantive economic activity and a clean UBO chain; (3) an EMI cannot provide BMD domestic clearing, Local POS acquiring, or Commercial LC issuance, all of which require a licensed Bermuda bank; (4) Bermuda economic-substance filings must still evidence core income-generating activity in Bermuda, so the primary treasury account should remain with a fully licensed Bermuda bank, with the EMI used only as a secondary sweep rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A hybrid regime applies. Bermuda's AML/ATF Code of Practice permits reliance on an acceptable introducer (a licensed Bermuda corporate services provider or registered agent) for the underlying KYC, but tier-1 Bermuda banks (HSBC Bermuda, Butterfield, Clarien) in practice require at least an in-person or live-video compliance interview with the ultimate beneficial owner(s) and at least one director of the Exempted Company before account activation. Remote-only opening is generally unavailable for a newly formed, non-resident-owned Exempted Company; physical presence in Bermuda, or a scheduled senior-officer video interview as a documented exception, is effectively mandatory. UK- or China-resident directors must budget for this onboarding interview, and the registered agent's money-laundering reporting officer should sponsor the file, although the bank retains final interview discretion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain opacity — nominee shareholding or layered Chinese/UK holding structure obscures the natural-person owners of the Bermuda Exempted Company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry extracts tracing ownership from the UK parent through to the Exempted Company; passport copies and residential-address proof for all natural-person UBOs; notarized nominee declaration and Declaration of Trust where applicable; a clear corporate-organisation chart; and a cover letter from the Bermuda registered agent confirming the non-resident designation and the identity of the ultimate beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-geography mismatch — royalty disbursements to Chinese master-brand counterparties from a Bermuda entity while Local POS revenues arise from UK/European franchisees, triggering questions about the commercial rationale of the offshore holding vehicle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed and notarized Chinese Malatang master franchise agreement; brand licensing schedule with royalty computation formula; pro-forma invoices and revenue reconciliations for outbound master-royalty wires; UK/European sub-franchise agreements supporting Local POS flows; an economic-substance file (board minutes, physical office, staff and expenditure in Bermuda); and an ISIC 5610 revenue model note explaining the cross-border royalty structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds insufficiency for the initial capital injection from the UK parent, where the parent's wealth formation is not transparent to the receiving Bermuda bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of UK parent bank statements; audited or certified financial statements of the parent; board resolution authorizing the capital contribution; allotment resolution and share certificates of the Bermuda Exempted Company; updated register of members; copies of UK tax returns or clearance certificates; and any lawful source-of-wealth documents such as sale-and-purchase agreements, dividend vouchers or inheritance instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening hits — Chinese beneficial owners or franchisee counterparties generating false-positive name matches on sanction lists, or adverse-media flags in PEP databases.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions-screening report from a licensed screening vendor with case-by-case resolution; passport-based name, date-of-birth and nationality verification; corroborative business licences and trade registry extracts of the Chinese counterparty; enhanced due diligence questionnaire; and a compliance-memorandum prepared by the Bermuda registered agent explaining the lawful nature of the franchise relationship and the absence of true OFAC/EU/UN designations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: UK parent (GB) initiates an SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 COV for USD-cleared cover) from its UK bank into the Bermuda Exempted Company's USD account at HSBC Bermuda or Butterfield, with the US-dollar leg cleared through the correspondent network (CHIPS/Fedwire). UK outward-reporting purpose code 'INVC' (Investment Capital) must be quoted, with a field-70 narrative reading 'Bermuda Exempted Company share subscription — capital injection.' Because the Exempted Company holds non-resident exchange-control designation, no BMA approval is required for the inward remittance. Verification bundle for the receiving bank: board resolution of the UK parent authorizing the contribution; allotment resolution and share certificate of the Bermuda entity; updated register of members; registered-agent compliance sign-off; and a source-of-funds pack comprising the UK shareholder's bank statements and audited financials. Capital may be subscribed in USD or BMD at the 1:1 peg; no statutory minimum capital applies, but a subscription amount commensurate with the master-franchise expansion plan strengthens the entity's economic-substance file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two distinct clearing rails apply. (1) Master-royalty and licence disbursements to the Chinese Malatang brand owner are executed by SWIFT MT103 in USD (with MT202 COV) from the Bermuda bank through a New York correspondent (for example BNY Mellon or Citibank) to the Chinese beneficiary bank's US correspondent, with onshore CNY conversion occurring at the receiving bank; alternatively, settlement in offshore CNH is available where the Chinese counterparty holds a CNH account. (2) Equipment imports (self-serve broth vending machines and POS hardware) from China are supported by an Irrevocable Documentary Commercial Letter of Credit issued by the Bermuda bank, advised or confirmed through a Chinese advising bank, with inspection-certificate and transport-document conditions; low-value items may be handled by documentary collection (D/P). Local POS revenue from UK/European franchisees is captured by each franchisee's acquiring bank and remitted to the Bermuda treasury account as consolidated monthly royalty wires (SWIFT MT103), with sub-franchise agreement references quoted in field 70 for automated reconciliation against the royalty schedule. All USD clearing runs through New York correspondents; the BMD/USD peg eliminates any need for separate BMD conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/GBP) executed with BMA-authorized or investment-grade correspondent dealers to fix conversion of UK franchise royalty inflows into USD.
Offshore USD/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) settled in USD against the onshore CNY fixing, covering master-royalty outflows to China without requiring CNY physical delivery.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD/GBP and USD/CNH) for longer-tenor structural balance-sheet hedging of the intercompany loan and royalty streams.
Vanilla FX options (USD/GBP and USD/CNY NDF options) for non-linear risk management of contingent franchise expansion payments.
Natural-hedge netting structures maintaining matched USD/BMD and GBP sub-accounts to offset receivable and payable flows before external hedging.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: BMD 100 per month late fee after the 60-day window; unpaid government fees for 12 consecutive months trigger administrative strike-off after Official Gazette notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Confirmation (attached to Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Beneficial Ownership Unit), Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the Annual Return; updated within 30 days of any shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm the UBO register attracts fines up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment; persistent default may prevent filings of share transfers and lead to strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Team), Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year-end (e.g., 30 June for a 31 December year-end); notification at incorporation and upon any change in relevant activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial penalty BMD 5,000; continuing default BMD 10,000 per day; false statement may lead to a fine up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment of officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Franchise Trade License Renewal (food-service activity in operating jurisdiction)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local municipal or health licensing authority in the franchise operating country
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal per local franchise jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of restaurant operating license and prohibition on franchise renewal; not a Bermuda corporate register matter.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is compulsory for a Bermuda Exempted Company if it is listed, a bank, an insurer, a regulated fund, or a captive insurance undertaking; for other exempted companies, an audit may be waived by unanimous shareholder consent provided gross revenue does not exceed BMD 50 million and total assets do not exceed BMD 25 million.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by IASB is the default accounting framework for Bermuda exempted companies; US GAAP is acceptable for subsidiaries of US-reporting parents.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone annual UBO filing is required; the Annual Return confirms the currency of the Beneficial Ownership Register, and every substantial shareholding transfer requires a register amendment within 30 days; the register must be kept at the registered office and remains accessible to Bermuda authorities upon notice.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% — Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CITA); applies solely to Bermuda businesses forming part of an MNE group with consolidated annual revenue ≥ EUR 750 million; otherwise the exempted company bears a 0% income tax rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a standard Exempted Co: no Bermuda income tax, capital gains tax, VAT, or payroll tax. Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 certificate protects the entity from any new Bermudian income or capital tax until 2035; annual government fee only. CIT 15% operates only above the EUR 750M group threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Return (Companies Act 1981, s.76-80) — filed via the Registrar of Companies online eFiling portal; print schedules lodged at the registered office.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 7 months after the end of the exempted company's financial year; standard Dec 31 FYE must file by July 31 of the following calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company name, registration number, and date of incorporation as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must verify the exact registered name and number; a mismatch invalidates the filing and triggers default fines.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Bermuda; must be maintained throughout the filing year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign management must ensure the corporate secretary updates any change before the filing date; service of process is confirmed at this address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital; list of shareholders and percentage holdings; declaration that shares are beneficially held by non-residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Chinese and UK shareholders' full legal names, nationality, and passport numbers must be disclosed; nominee holdings must be flagged.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of directors and officers; description of principal business activity including ISIC 5610 (restaurants); franchise master licensing income flows.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the Chinese Malatang brand master-licensing model accurately; presenting an active royalty business as dormant is a criminal misrepresentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a default fine plus daily surcharge under Companies Act 1981; continued default leads to Registrar's strike-off and asset forfeiture to the Crown. Director disqualification may follow.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR) — Bermuda Tax Information Reporting (TIR) portal administered by the Ministry of Finance; mandatory for every exempted company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months after the financial year-end; Dec 31 FYE filing by June 30 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A — Entity and relevant activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identify the relevant activity: Intellectual Property Business (franchise IP licensing), Pure Equity Holding Entity, or other. The Malatang master licence arrangement is an IP Business unless the entity is dormant.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign management must not default to 'Pure Equity Holding' if active licensing revenue exists; misclassification is a penalised non-compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirm whether CIGA are undertaken in Bermuda: strategic decisions on brand acquisition and exploitation, contract negotiation, risk assumption, and royalty management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors in China/UK must evidence board minutes held in Bermuda and substantive local decisions; remote approval without local presence fails ESR.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State number of full-time employees, physical premises, and annual operating expenditure in Bermuda devoted to the IP business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero employees/premises renders the company a shell; minimum viable substance is one Bermuda-based officer, a serviced office, and local payroll costs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reference the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 certificate number and confirm continuing exempt status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the certificate PDF; non-resident principals must retain the original for banking and UK CFC documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Fixed late penalty BMD 2,500 plus BMD 250 per day of continued default; for non-compliance with substance the authority may levy up to BMD 250,000 and imprison responsible officers for up to 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT Return) — TIR portal; required exclusively where the Bermuda entity belongs to an MNE group with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750M in one of the two preceding years.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the tax year; the first mandatory CIT filing point is for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2025.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: GloBE jurisdiction identifier, ultimate parent entity details, and the group's consolidated revenue evidencing whether the EUR 750M threshold is met.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign holding companies must obtain the UPE's GloBE ID and confirm revenue figures in audited statements; sub-threshold entities file nil CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of covered taxes and qualified income; determination of any top-up tax liability at 15% before global blending.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a royalty-only Bermuda entity with UK-source income, verify UK withholding credits before computing the effective rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Arm's-length adjustments for intercompany royalty payments, brand licence fees, and management charges with related UK licensees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign management must supply a comparability analysis (CUP/TNMM benchmark) to support the royalty rate percentage.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating losses carried forward per CITA 2023; five-year carryforward period observed for qualifying losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss schedules must reconcile to Bermuda financial statements signed by the local registered auditor.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or erroneous return: penalty up to BMD 250,000; directors and officers liable to fines and imprisonment up to 5 years, with daily default surcharges and strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Bermuda does not impose any dividend withholding tax, income tax, or capital gains tax on distributions made by an Exempted Co to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive UK-Bermuda double taxation agreement exists. Dividend repatriation to a UK parent is wholly untaxed in Bermuda; relief is therefore administrative only. For UK tax purposes, the dividends may be exempt from UK Corporation Tax under the CTA 2009 Part 9A exemption if the UK recipient falls within an exempt class; no TRC is required in Bermuda, but UK shareholders must maintain board minutes and dividend vouchers to evidence beneficial ownership. If the Bermuda entity earns UK-source royalties, the UK payer must withhold 20% unless a UK statutory exemption applies; no treaty relief is available.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Bermuda statutory WHT on outbound royalties and interest: 0%. UK domestic WHT on UK-source royalty and interest remitted to Bermuda: 20% (no UK-Bermuda DTA, so no reduction). The UK-Malatang franchise royalty stream into the Bermuda entity will therefore suffer UK WHT unless the agreement is structured through a qualifying exemption or a PE holding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory Local File/Master File for sub-threshold exempted companies under Bermuda law. Mandatory documentation (CbCR, Master File, Local File) applies only to MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ BMD 750,000,000 (≈ EUR 750M) under the CIT/GloBE framework. For a small franchise master licence vehicle, maintain a contemporaneous arm's-length royalty benchmark (TNMM/CUP) to defend the royalty rate before HMRC.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Bermuda ESR 2018 applies. The Malatang master licensing activity is an Intellectual Property Business requiring CIGA in Bermuda: strategic IP acquisition/exploitation decisions, risk assumption, and contract negotiations. The entity must maintain local premises, full-time employees, and proportionate expenditure. A dormant or pure-equity exemption is unavailable where active royalty income exists. UK CFC rules (TIOPA 2010 Part 9A) and HMRC's global anti-avoidance review will independently test substance against UK activities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Presenting the Bermuda Exempted Co as active IP master licensor while all management, brand development, and licensing decisions occur in the UK; zero Bermuda employees, premises, or expenditure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment of responsible officers up to 5 years; Registrar strike-off and dissolution; UK CFC charge on apportioned profits (up to 25% UK CT).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: directors jointly and severally liable for penalties and unpaid UK CFC tax; HMRC may apply CGT/IT charges on personal benefits; travel bans and passport surrender on asset dissipation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an Annual Return declaring dormant status while franchise royalties are received; understating licensing revenue; false declaration of non-resident shareholding to mask Chinese ultimate beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda: fines up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years per offence; UK: tax-geared penalty up to 200% of avoided tax and criminal investigation for fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, civil restitution of avoided tax plus interest, director disqualification (Companies Act 1981 and UK CDDA 1986), and international extradition arrest in serious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Chinese Malatang franchise master fees without source-of-funds verification; routing royalty proceeds through personal or third-party accounts; concealing the ultimate beneficial owner from banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda AML/ATF Regulations 2008: unlimited fines and imprisonment up to 14 years under anti-money laundering legislation; UK POCA 2002 parallel offences; bank account freezes and client funds forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors liable for failing to prevent facilitation of tax evasion (UK Criminal Finances Act 2017); personal confiscation orders, travel bans, and disqualification from holding financial services functions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging inflated royalty rates to UK operating subsidiaries for the Malatang brand while the Bermuda entity lacks people functions and bears no real economic risk; artificial profit diversion from the UK.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UK CFC apportionment at up to 25% of diverted IP-condition profits; transfer pricing adjustment of intercompany royalty; interest and penalties up to 200% of the avoided UK tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the UK parent face personal liability for unremitted PAYE-like CFC charges arranged by them; HMRC may issue personal liability notices and impose travel bans for deliberate wrongdoing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the Annual Return within 7 months and the ESR declaration within 6 months of FYE; non-payment of the annual government fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic default fines, daily surcharges, then dissolution by the Registrar; assets vested in the Crown; loss of the tax protection certificate and UK bank accounts frozen.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for continuing penalties; restoration proceedings at personal cost; creditors may sue directors for trading after strike-off notice; immigration bans for fraudulent continuation.
